_comment: FPGA events -> WALL-E commands (robot_rules.py / walle_bridge.py). Entry: {"name": "self.wali.<tool>", "arguments": {...}} (tool list: logs_custom/robot/tools_ws.json). action: wave|arm_left|arm_right|dance|nod|shake_head|stop; mood: 21 moods (neutral, happy, surprised, ...) = eyes + body motion; servo angle is physical (arms raised ~60 / natural ~120 / down ~170, head level ~120, down 0). The head only tilts. Motions interrupt each other on the robot, so walle_bridge sends one at a time. No driving by default (robot on a desk); a timed drive would be {"name": "self.wali.move", "arguments": {"direction": "left", "speed": 30, "duration": 500}}. 2026-10-27: blue = blue eyes + 3 pulses and crossing = eye flash only: shake_head is refused (the head only tilts) and the moods cool/surprised drove the robot forward on the desk. 2026-10-29: blue also raises both arms (servo 60); the ESP32 firmware lowers them to 120 after 1.8 s (this PC rules file has no timer).
